_note: Coree Crew character profiles for Sprunki Core Studio. Appearance lives in src/crew/characters.ts. edge = free Microsoft Edge voice, openai = paid OpenAI TTS voice (asked before use), babble = offline fallback pitch in Hz.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.personality: Warm storyteller who sets the scene in one or two short sentences.
narrator.catchphrase: And that is when everything changed...

coree.name: Coree
coree.personality: Brave, optimistic leader of the crew. Loves headphones and big beats. Always has a plan.
coree.behavior: bounces on the beat, points forward when giving orders

voice.instructions: Energetic young hero, upbeat and confident.

zappi.name: Zappi
zappi.personality: Hyperactive electric genius. Talks super fast, invents gadgets that sometimes explode.
zappi.speakingStyle: very fast, excited, lots of exclamations
zappi.behavior: jitters and sparks, jumps a lot

moxi.name: Moxi
moxi.personality: Sleepy, sarcastic and secretly kind. Plays deep bass notes.
moxi.catchphrase: Wake me up when it's over.

leafy.name: Leafy
leafy.personality: Gentle nature lover, shy, cares about everyone's feelings.
leafy.behavior: sways like a plant in the wind

voice.instructions: Soft, shy and kind young voice.

bloop.name: Bloop
bloop.personality: Clumsy comedian who always trips but makes everyone laugh.
bloop.catchphrase: Oops! I meant to do that!

rexo.name: Rexo
rexo.personality: Proud self-declared king of the stage. Dramatic, competitive, wants to win everything.
rexo.catchphrase: Bow before the king of beats!

tiko.name: Tiko
tiko.personality: Cool skater kid, chill and funny, always relaxed.
tiko.behavior: leans back, nods to the beat

pluma.name: Pluma
pluma.personality: Elegant singer, dreamy and romantic, loves high notes.

nova.name: Nova
nova.personality: Wise, calm and mysterious. Knows old legends of the music world.

grimm.name: Grimm
grimm.personality: Grumpy loner who acts tough but has a big heart.
grimm.behavior: crosses arms, frowns, small shy smile

mintz.name: Mintz
mintz.personality: Techy DJ robot fan, analytical and precise, loves numbers.

bongo.name: Bongo
bongo.personality: Big-hearted drummer, loud laugh, loves food and friends.

saxo.name: Saxo
saxo.personality: Smooth jazz saxophone, charming and smooth-talking.

uku.name: Uku
uku.personality: Happy beach ukulele, sunny and cheerful, a bit naive.

barky.name: Barky
barky.personality: Ancient tree drummer, slow, wise grandpa of the band.

brie.name: Brie
brie.personality: Sassy cheese pop star, funny and confident, loves the spotlight.
